name: @rauf/pi-extension
description: Hand-written source of rauf's Pi extensions (rauf-loop-supervisor). scripts/build-pi-bundle.ts copies extensions/ into adapters/pi/extensions/ (and vendors packages/core/src/item-card.ts into it); pi loads the .ts directly. The pi packages here are devDependencies for typechecking only: at runtime pi provides @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, @earendil-works/pi-tui and typebox to extensions.
